shape.description: Controls server-side ownership checks. INHERIT uses the tenant default, then ownership.enabled. Omitted on create means inherit; omitted on update leaves the setting unchanged. When enabled, agent keys need a bound userId or verified delegated user token to access personal content; keys without a user ID can access only shared content within their store grants. Existing ownerless records become hidden and Summary Views with a different ownership policy must be recreated. Disabling restores legacy access. Changes propagate through the metadata cache.

new value, and a resource never gets a value it had before. Compare for equality

`revision`; sent back as `expectedRevision` to make a write conditional. Omitting
`expectedRevision` makes the write unconditional.

Unix seconds after which the key no longer authenticates; 0 or omitted means never.

Grants where an empty list is not a meaningful answer. On create and update, an
explicitly supplied but empty list is a caller mistake rather than a request to
clear grants. On API-key introspection, reporting an active key with no grants
would read to a data plane as an authenticated caller with no authorization, so
the response must either carry grants or fail.
